ruins.name: Flying Submarine
ruins.clue: Every submarine has one button marked EMERGENCY. Nobody said whose emergency.

ruins.name: Ship Beside a Bottle
ruins.clue: The keeper keeps a hammer on the floor. Bottles are mostly a suggestion.

ruins.name: Sold the Sub
ruins.clue: One stall at the auction buys something you happen to be sitting in. Then bid.

ruins.name: Inked Captain
ruins.clue: Octopuses are very ticklish. Octopuses are also full of ink.

ruins.name: Submarine Weathervane
ruins.clue: Whales can sneeze. Lighthouses have very pointy tops.
